name: A Cliche Romance
source:
It's your last year in high school. You're pretty sociable and try to become friends with Aoi, a girl famous for her stunning looks and intelligence. Although she's had countless boys confess to her, she always seems to be turning them down. Will you be able to win her heart over?

[From [url=https://peachypink.itch.io/a-cliche-romance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你高中的最后一年。你很善于交际，并试图与葵成为朋友，葵是一个以迷人的外表和智慧而闻名的女孩。虽然有无数男生向她表白，但她似乎总是拒绝。你能赢得她的心吗？

[来自[url=https://peachypink.itch.io/a-cliche-romance]itch.io[/url]]
